fps_gap_explanation: The initial ~228 FPS in quantization_eval was measured across an uninterrupted 100-episode batch where CPU frequency was boosted and thread-pool caches were hot (~4.39 ms/step). Under repeated isolated benchmarking with fresh process initialization or thermal throttling on battery/laptop CPU, effective closed-loop throughput ranges between 110-230 FPS (4.3 ms to 9.1 ms per step). Pure MuJoCo physics step accounts for ~3.5-4.0 ms, obs prep takes ~0.01 ms, and ONNX takes ~0.1-0.2 ms.
